name: AKINCI-5
summary: The fifth robot in a Turkish humanoid line that began as an R&D project in 2009, built at AKINROBOTICS' factory in Konya — opened in 2017 and billed as the world's first plant dedicated to humanoid production. Where AKINCI-1 through 4 were service and demonstration machines, AKINCI-5 is aimed at manufacturing, logistics and mining, and is still in testing.
notable: Turkey's long-running domestic humanoid program, started 2009
Built at a factory dedicated to humanoid production
